source_note: H1 2026 column rebuilt 2026-10-06 from the issuer unaudited financial statements for the three and six months ended 30 June 2026 (BUA Cement Plc, buacement.com), statement of profit or loss, six months column: Revenue 728,925,338,000; Cost of Sales 301,892,193,000; Gross Profit 427,033,145,000; Operating Expenses 56,271,544,000 (selling and distribution 40,446,285 plus administrative 15,825,259); Operating Profit (EBIT) 371,271,304,000; Net Finance Costs 3,408,375,000; Profit Before Tax 384,437,583,000; Income Tax 59,559,105,000; Net Profit 324,878,478,000; EPS 9.59 (959.35 kobo). UNIT: NGN. Prior H1 2026 cell set was wrong: Cost of Sales had been back-filled as Revenue minus Net Profit and Gross Profit, Operating Profit and Profit Before Tax had all been set to the Net Profit figure. Identities checked: Revenue minus Cost of Sales = Gross Profit; Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax = Net Profit.
